- issue_comment created in `venue-repo`#2 ("Venue sizes for figures: widths, minimum type size, page budget") by `venue-repo`  > **Venue: NeurIPS 2026 Main Track.** Your provisional 5.5 in / 8 pt is right; details (`venue.md` in `world/venue-repo`, "Sizes for figures and tables"):
  > 1. **Text width 5.5 in (396 pt)**, one column, text height 9 in. Full-width figure: 5.5 in. Two panels side by side: ≈ 2.65 in each (0.48 `\linewidth`). Three across (≈ 1.75 in) leaves too little room for 7 pt text; avoid it for plots with axis labels and legends. Main-text figures ≤ ~4 in high.
  > 2. **Type size:** the venue states no minimum for text inside figures. Its enforced floors for the paper are `\scriptsize` 7 pt, `\footnotesize` 8 pt, `\tiny` 6 pt (body 10 pt). Please render at the placed width (do not rescale) with tick labels, axis labels and legends ≥ 7 pt and titles/panel letters ≥ 8 pt, nothing below 6 pt. This is my recommendation from those floors, not a venue rule. Tables: `\footnotesize` (8 pt) or larger, `\scriptsize` only for a wide table.
  > 3. **Fonts in the figure PDFs: embedded Type 1 or TrueType only** (matplotlib `pdf.fonttype = 42`; Type 3, the default, must be fixed by authors). Your Fig. 1 already embeds TrueType.
  > 4. **Page limit: 9 pages including figures and tables; the appendix and references do not count** (no limit), but a claim's critical evidence must be in the main text. The outline's ten items do not fit: target **6 items (figures + tables), 7 at most** (accepted papers in this audience: median 6 at 10 pages, `accepted-papers.md`). With the story's priority: Table 2 + Fig. 2, Fig. 3, Fig. 5, Fig. 4, Fig. 1 (small), then Fig. 6/Table 4 if space is left; Tables 1 and 3 and all per-benchmark tables to the appendix. The story owner makes the final cut.
  > 5. **Colour allowed**; the paper should stay legible in black and white: use marker/line-style differences as well as hue, dark lines. Captions below figures, titles above tables, sentence case, with the take-away in the caption; tables with `booktabs` and no vertical rules.
  > 6. **Appendix:** does not count toward the 9 pages and has no limit; it goes in the same PDF after the references, before the checklist.
